status: Adult-use licensed under MRTMA (retail since December 2019); medical facilities under MMFLA. Regulator: Cannabis Regulatory Agency (CRA).

facts.label: Statewide adult-use sales, July 2026
facts.source: Michigan Cannabis Regulatory Agency, Monthly Report July 1 - July 31, 2026, Adult-Use Establishment Licensing sec. 1 Product Sales, 'July Total' row
facts.verify: Parse the docx (zipfile + word/document.xml). Sales by Product Type table under Adult-Use sec. 1: July Total $270,539,568.39. Exact page value $270,539,568.39, rounded down on page copy.

facts.label: Cumulative adult-use sales since market open
facts.source: CRA Monthly Report July 2026, Additional Sales Information table, 'Sales To Date (July 31)'

facts.label: Average adult-use retail flower price per ounce, July 2026
facts.source: CRA Monthly Report July 2026, Additional Sales Information, 'Average Retail Flower Price (oz.)'
facts.verify: Cell label includes '(oz.)'. Medical equivalent is $78.86/oz in the MMFLA section.

facts.label: Active adult-use retailer licenses statewide
facts.source: CRA Monthly Report July 2026, Adult-Use sec. 7 Active Licenses table
facts.verify: Active Licenses table: Retailer 836. Same table: Class A Grower 9, Class B 68, Class C 798, Excess Grower 61, Processor 268, Microbusiness 6, Class A Microbusiness 8, Secure Transporter 21, Safety Compliance 20, Designated Consumption 6, Event Organizer 31.

facts.label: Employees in licensed cannabis businesses statewide
facts.source: CRA Monthly Report July 2026, sec. 21 Total Number of Employees Under the MMFLA and MRTMA
facts.verify: Number of Employees, As of July 31: 41,257.

facts.label: Wayne County adult-use sales, July 2026
facts.source: CRA Monthly Report July 2026, Adult-Use sec. 22 Sales By Region, Wayne table, 'July Total'
facts.verify: Wayne regional table July Total $30,649,103.63. Wayne is broken out as its own region; share of statewide July sales = 30,649,104 / 270,539,568 = 11.3%. CRA regional tables are the only sub-state sales the state publishes; city-level sales are not published.

facts.label: Statewide medical facility sales, July 2026
facts.source: CRA Monthly Report July 2026, Medical Marijuana Facility Licensing sec. 1 Product Sales, 'July Total'
facts.verify: MMFLA Product Sales July Total $311,725.63, versus $270.5M adult-use: medical is roughly 0.1% of licensed retail sales. Active Provisioning Centers: 87.

facts.label: Registered medical marijuana patients statewide
facts.source: CRA Monthly Report July 2026, MMMP registry table 'As of July 31', Total row
facts.verify: County table Total 52,115. Wayne County 9,433 patients, the largest county count. Registry counts only; no condition data is used on any page.

facts.label: Licensed adult-use retail marijuana businesses in Detroit
facts.source: City of Detroit, Licensed Marijuana Locations Dashboard (BSEED), KPI 'CNT(LICENSED_MARIJUANA_BUSINESSES)' for License Type = Retail
facts.verify: The dashboard queries the city database live; captured the vizql bootstrap payload and read the KPI worksheet: Retail 67, Medical Marijuana Provisioning Center 34. Map worksheet lists 85 distinct business names at 90 mapped license points (some addresses hold both license types).

facts.label: Licensed retail stores and microbusinesses in Detroit (FY2025 excise distribution basis)
facts.source: Michigan Department of Treasury, Adult-Use Marijuana Distributions based on FY2025 revenues (paid February 2026); license counts as of 9/30/2025 per the document
facts.verify: Row '82-2050 Detroit City Wayne 61 3,295,043.10'. 61 x $54,017.10 per license = $3,295,043.10 exactly. Detroit's 61 is the largest municipal count in the file. Statewide: 860 licenses across 234 municipalities, $93,773,685.60 distributed. Wayne County row 82-0000: 98 licenses, $5,293,675.80.

facts.label: Detroit's FY2025 adult-use excise tax distribution
facts.source: Michigan Department of Treasury, Adult-Use Marijuana Distributions based on FY2025 revenues, February 2026
facts.verify: $3,295,043.10 to the City of Detroit; $54,017.10 per eligible license statewide.

facts.label: Active City of Detroit marijuana facility business licenses (all facility types)
facts.source: City of Detroit BSEED, Business Licenses (Current) open dataset, license_type = 'Medical Marijuana Facility License' (the city's single marijuana facility license type)
facts.verify: 154 rows; dataset DCAT modified 2026-08-24. Bulk CSV: https://data.detroitmi.gov/api/download/v1/items/2addfbf566464896b4aa032ac873549b/csv?layers=0. Covers all city-licensed marijuana facilities (not only retail); do not conflate with the state Treasury count of 61 retail stores or the city dashboard's 67 retail KPI.

facts.label: Medical marijuana provisioning centers in Detroit
facts.source: City of Detroit, Licensed Marijuana Locations Dashboard (BSEED), KPI for License Type = Medical Marijuana Provisioning Center
facts.verify: Same capture as det-retail-licenses. 34 of Michigan's 87 statewide provisioning centers are in Detroit (39%).

gaps: Detroit city-level sales dollars: not published by CRA or the city. Wayne County ($30.6M July 2026) is the closest official figure; never present it as Detroit-only.
August 2026 data: July 2026 is the latest complete CRA month at retrieval.

Three Detroit license counts exist and must never be mixed on a page without their dates and lenses: 61 (state Treasury, retail stores + microbusinesses, as of 2025-09-30), 67 (city dashboard KPI, retail, live query 2026-08-24), 154 (city BSEED, all facility types, 2026-08-24). Pick one per claim and date it.
CRA monthly reports from March 2026 onward are .docx, earlier months .pdf; the parse method is zipfile + word/document.xml.
Detroit adult-use opt-in history (2021 ordinance, litigation, first licenses): no primary document on file; do not assert dates until one is fetched.
Michigan's adult-use excise tax rate (10% statutory under MRTMA): no primary rate document on file; pages cite the Treasury distribution without asserting the rate.
